title: A retention report that compares October's setup-completers with July's whole cohort, against the weakest month of the baseline

planted.why: 58% is 81 of the 140 July v2 users who finished setup; the v2 cohort as a whole retained 104 of 200 (52%), and the baseline is all sign-ups
April (41 of 100) is the lowest baseline month; April to June pooled is 140 of 300 (46.7%), so the like-for-like gain is about 5 points, not 17

proof.python:
import csv
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('signups.csv')))
def ret(sel):
    r = [x for x in rows if sel(x)]
    return sum(int(x['retained_day30']) for x in r), len(r)
assert ret(lambda x: x['month'] == '2026-04') == (41, 100)
assert ret(lambda x: x['flow'] == 'v1') == (140, 300)
assert ret(lambda x: x['flow'] == 'v2') == (104, 200)
assert ret(lambda x: x['flow'] == 'v2' and x['completed_setup'] == '1') == (81, 140)
assert round(81 / 140 * 100) == 58 and round(104 / 200 * 100) == 52 and round(140 / 300 * 100, 1) == 46.7
